root_idea.summary: The root centers on turning or returning a thing from its course, state, or relation, including redirecting it, replacing it, or causing it to change.
root_idea.development: From this core developed uses for diversion and aversion, variation between forms or states, exchange and expenditure, purity through removal of admixture, and the vicissitudes that turn people or affairs about.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form I verb with distinct turning-away and directing uses.
Quran-attested Form II verb, especially variation and varied presentation of signs.
Quran-attested Form VII verb meaning to turn or go away.
Quran-attested verbal noun with a specific construction concerning inability to avert punishment.
Quran-attested noun for a place or way of turning away.
Quran-attested Form II verbal noun for variation or directing between states.

senses.definition: To turn, divert, send, or put away or back from a course; to avert or repel.
senses.usage_conditions: Used transitively and in passive constructions, often with عَنْ to mark what someone or something is turned away from. Quranic contexts include diverting people, averting harm or punishment, and turning hearts or attention away from belief or signs.

senses.definition: To turn or direct someone or something toward a person, place, or matter.
senses.usage_conditions: The directed object may be expressed with إِلَى. This use describes bringing a group or attention toward a destination or object rather than turning it away.

senses.definition: To vary, diversify, distribute, or turn something through different forms, directions, or states.
senses.usage_conditions: Form II commonly conveys repeated, multiple, or intensified variation. It is used in Quranic contexts for varying natural phenomena and distributing or presenting a matter in differing ways.

senses.definition: To set out or restate signs, verses, or discourse in varied forms so that their meanings become distinct or clear.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the Quranic construction تَصْرِيفُ الآيَاتِ and related expressions: meanings are made distinct through repetition, variation, or differing presentation.

senses.definition: To turn or go away or back; to withdraw or depart from a place, course, or undertaking.
senses.usage_conditions: The Form VII subject may be a person or thing. In the Quranic occurrence it describes people turning away after hearing or encountering something, with the exact implication supplied by context.

senses.definition: Averting or repelling something, especially punishment or harm.
senses.usage_conditions: In فَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا, the noun denotes the ability to avert punishment from themselves or to turn themselves away from the fire.

senses.definition: A means or capacity for changing a matter from one state to another; by extension, artifice or cunning for warding something off.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic phrase is also interpreted as inability to alter the matter or employ an evasive resource. This sense explains renderings that emphasize artifice rather than direct aversion.

senses.definition: A place or way of turning away, retreat, or escape.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا عَنْهَا مَصْرِفًا, it denotes no place or route by which to turn away from the fire.

senses.definition: Turned away, averted, or prevented from reaching its object.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic phrase لَيْسَ مَصْرُوفًا عَنْهُمْ, the implied object is the punishment: it will not be turned away from them.

senses.definition: Variation, alternation, or directing from one state, course, or condition to another.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, the verbal noun is used with the winds and their changing or directed courses. It expresses the process rather than a single act of turning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The turning or separation of roads into distinct directions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the reported construction concerning roads whose courses diverge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Exchange, especially exchanging one kind of money for another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for giving gold, silver, dirhams, or dinars in exchange for one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To expend property or money, especially in purchasing goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived noun may describe putting money into commercial transactions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Embellishment of speech, including additions or stylistic elaboration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression can describe making discourse attractive or turning listeners’ attention toward it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave a beverage unmixed, or to drink wine unmixed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized verb construction is used with beverage or wine and does not mean ordinary turning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grate a canine tooth against its opposite so as to make a sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person or camel; the resulting sound is the relevant lexical effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal, to be in heat or lust after the male.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence explicitly applies this use to female animals, especially a bitch and also certain hoofed or predatory animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Morphological derivation and inflection: forming related words by modifying their patterns, including noun declension and verb conjugation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the technical linguistic use of the verbal noun and the name of the related grammatical discipline.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To employ someone in managing an affair with discretion or freedom of action; sometimes, to make use of artifice or cunning in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person and an affair; the ordinary sense concerns discretionary management, while cunning is an attributed extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exercise a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form II use applied to training or exercising the animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dealing, or buying and selling, with another person through exchange or commercial artifice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence leaves open whether the expression refers specifically to monetary exchange or to artful dealing more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a face, to turn about or become turned about.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V reflexive or quasi-passive use describing the face’s change of orientation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become employed or used in more than one way, as though shifted from one way to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a Form V quasi-passive use concerning the thing’s possible applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act freely or resourcefully in managing an affair; also to use artifice or cunning in it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence records both discretionary management and a figurative interpretation involving versatility or craft.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to be exercised.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form V use for the animal’s training or exercise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or obtain sustenance or gain, using resourcefulness or artifice in doing so.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may specify seeking gain for one’s family or household.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn one’s face away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form VIII construction parallel to turning the face aside.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To procure dirhams in exchange for other dirhams or for dinars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized monetary-exchange use of Form VIII.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or beg God to avert disliked things or adverse events.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction takes hardships or disliked events as what is sought to be turned away.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The vicissitudes, mishaps, or calamities of time and fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a substantive, with the plural صُرُوف, for events that turn people or circumstances about.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Repentance or turning back from wrongdoing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning is recorded especially in the paired expression لا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلَا عَدْلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The superiority, excess, or difference in value or excellence of one coin or piece of speech over another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense applies to money and, by extension, to the relative excellence of speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The night and the day considered as alternating counterparts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This plural-like substantive is explained through their interchange.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the paired expression لا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلَا عَدْلٌ, a compensatory, evasive, or otherwise offered resource; reported interpretations include repentance, artifice, gain, extra value, weight, or deviation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression has several transmitted interpretations; it should not be reduced to one universal standalone meaning without context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pure, unmixed, or free from admixture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to wine, beverage, blood, phlegm, and other things when nothing is mixed into them or obscures their essential quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A red dye used for coloring or tanning leather and sandal straps.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material noun for the dye or red coloring substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mansion of the Moon, identified with a bright star in Leo.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper astronomical term whose name is explained through the turning away of heat or cold at its rising or setting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of bead believed to captivate, restrain, or conciliate a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A traditional object associated with turning a person from one course of conduct to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow marked with a black spot whose arrows are said not to strike the aimed object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized traditional term for this type of bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manner or interval of milking a she-camel in the early morning and leaving her until the corresponding time the next day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an idiomatic temporal use rather than a general noun for milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized name for death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lead; according to one attribution, copper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence records both lead and an alternative identification with copper.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A heavy, tough variety of dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The singular is reported as صَرَفَانَة; regional identifications vary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel of a certain excellent sort.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form and root assignment are disputed in the evidence, which also reports a preferred variant with د.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that makes a grating or creaking sound with her teeth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal epithet derived from the tooth-grating sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A creaking, grating, or rasping sound, such as that of a pulley, door, writing reed, or camel tooth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may also describe the sound made by rubbing or grating teeth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk just drawn from the udder, while still hot or freshly obtained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for fresh milk before it has cooled or otherwise settled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dry palm branch or other tree growth that has become dry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is also reported for dried vegetation or a dry palm frond.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Silver, especially pure silver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material noun attested in poetic usage and explained alternatively as pure silver.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thin, round cake of bread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural forms reported are صُرُف and صِرَاف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine from Ṣarīfūn in Iraq; according to another explanation, wine freshly drawn from its jar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence preserves both the place-name derivation and the alternative freshness-based interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Making a creaking or grating sound, especially a tooth or sandal thong that creaks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial adjective for the source of the sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled in artifice or cunning in managing affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can be applied figuratively to a sharp, incisive tongue.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A money-changer who distinguishes the relative quality or value of coins.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related forms صَرَّاف and صَيْرَفِيّ may differ in intensity; the latter denotes the money-changing occupation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The varieties, changes, or vicissitudes of affairs and events.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually used in the expression تَصَارِيفُ الأُمُورِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place, scope, or room for free action and maneuver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive or quasi-passive description of what allows discretionary movement or management.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An agent, factor, or deputy who acts according to his own discretion in managing an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use concerns an authorized person with freedom of action, not the grammatical sense of a fully inflected verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of turning away or back; also the verbal noun of اِنْصَرَفَ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place noun is parallel to مَصْرِف; its verbal-noun use is grammatical in origin.

cautions: Lane's printed Quran citations use historical conventions and include references that do not always match modern verse numbering; modern example locations here are taken only from the secure QAC occurrences. In particular, مَصْرِف is located at 18:53 by QAC despite the Lane citation notation.
The Quranic phrase involving صَرْف in 25:19 has multiple transmitted interpretations, represented separately under the form rather than treated as interchangeable translations.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Lane's Form VII entry reports, without naming an authority for the claim, a possible meaning of اِنْصَرَفَ as running in a small stream. It is retained as ambiguous rather than assigned as a Classical meaning.
